Jordan (release): FYI were lining up a small wave tonight 23:30 UTC (change window). Targets: API routing changes, runtime quantizer-v3, console opt-in flag, router header split. Want a quick pass on pins + known risks. @deploy-bot can you queue?

deploy-bot: OK: queued release wave rw-1768734000 for 2026-03-21T23:30:00Z. Preflight at 23:00 UTC. Commands: `/deploy status rw-1768734000`, `/deploy preflight rw-1768734000`.

Riya (api): API: route pin set to canary-route:v2.1. No schema migration. I added a fallback route to v2.0.8 if we need to circuit. Patch snippet: `PATCH /routes/canary -d '{"target":"v2.0.8","meta":{"reason":"fallback"}}'`

Marco (runtime): Runtime note: quantizer-v3 uses new kernel path and increases cold start memory ~8%. Canary pool sized x3 hosts. I've applied kernel param `--kv-warmup=on`. Watch metric: runtime.kernel_warmup.time and runtime.mem.resid.

Noor (console): Console: UI toggle `enableSchemaStrict` will default to off during rollout and flip on at 50% if healthy. I added a one-click rollback button in the release view (internal only).

Diego (router): Router validated header-split in QA. Plan: phased rollout 5% -> 20% -> 60% with 10m holds. Will attach header: `X-Rw-Route: canary`.

Jordan (release): Rollback triggers? propose: 10m sustained error-rate >0.5% OR p95 +40ms sustained for 10m OR any canary OOM. Thoughts?

Lex (oncall): Agree but tighten error-rate to >0.4% for first 15m. Also trigger on any increase in 5xx spike from model backends. I'll be watching.

Marco (runtime): If we hit OOMs, immediate plan: demote quantizer-v3 on canary to quant-v2: `runtime action demote --release rw-1768734000 --to quant-v2`. Also scale canary pool +5 nodes.

Riya (api): If we rollback API, unpin the canary route and purge cache keys: `curl -XPOST https://api.internal/purge -d 'routes=canary-route'`

Noor (console): Console rollback: flip `enableSchemaStrict=false` and click rollback button. Also I'll remove client-facing warning banner only if rollout completes without issues.

deploy-bot: Dry-run completed at 22:50 UTC: smoke tests passed. Canary health checks registered. Preflight scheduled 23:00 UTC.

Jordan (release): Preflight checklist: smoke endpoints, canary warmup, metric baselines, release notes link. I'm adding a short runbook to the thread.

Lex (oncall): Runbook highlights I'll watch: p95 latency, error-rate, OOM count, kv-eviction rate. I'll escalate if multiple alerts fire.

Diego (router): Note: router header-split also changes cache-keying. Might see a slight cache miss bump at first. Watch `router.cache.miss_rate` for first 30m.

Marco (runtime): Agree. I expect a cache miss spike then steady. We should allow 15m warmup before moving beyond 20% traffic.

Riya (api): One more: telemetry tag `release=rw-1768734000` added to all canary requests. Helps slicing.

Jordan (release): OK timeline: preflight 23:00, final go/no-go 23:20, rollout 23:30 start (5% -> hold 10m -> 20% -> hold 10m -> 60% -> final). Be on #release-watch.

Noor (console): I'll be standing by to flip the UI toggle if needed.

Lex (oncall): I'll be present until 00:30 UTC. If I hit thresholds I'll post ROLLBACK and coordinate.

Riya (api): Quick reminder: if rollback happens, clients might send sticky headers. Unset sticky header in router if rolling back.

Jordan (release): Thanks. TL;DR: queued rw-1768734000, preflight 23:00, pinned canary route & telemetry, rollback criteria set, runbook noted. Final go/no-go at 23:20.

deploy-bot: Noted. Will post preflight logs and step outputs to this thread during execution. Good luck! :thumbsup:
